title: I Have to Go
how: I Have to Go is picked up automatically during Orientation, while you search for Jesse and complete the ritual.

title: I Feel It
how: I Feel It is picked up automatically in The Incursion Fault, the part of Search For Jesse where you learn to use Shift on vertical walls.

title: Repeating, Refracting
how: Repeating, Refracting is picked up automatically in The Subway Fault, where you learn to use Reach on orbs to get to higher and further areas.

title: Before I Leave
how: Before I Leave is picked up automatically after you complete The Underpass Fault.

title: I’m Sorry
how: I’m Sorry is picked up automatically after you complete The House In Distress, when Jesse and Dylan fail to close the Fault in the Oldest House.

title: Jesse’s ID
how: On your way to leave the Oldest House, Jesse’s ID is on the desk next to Dimensional Research: Slide Repairs, one of the Ordinary AWE collectibles.

title: Memo On The Role Of The Director
how: Complete Welcome to Manhattan at the Central Field Office to get the Security Level 01 keycard. Use the fast travel door at the Field Office to return to the Oldest House. On the same level as the fast travel door, open the Security Level 01 door. Memo On The Role Of The Director is on the main desk to the left.

title: Contingency Protocol For HRAs
how: Complete the story quest Evacuation Procedures to get the Level 02 keycard. Open the Security Level 02 door next to the Oldest House: Central Executive fast travel door. Contingency Protocol For HRAs is on the table inside.

title: Jesse’s Notes To Self
how: After you leave P6 Holding, you reach a security checkpoint and take the elevator down to the executive office. Before you head to the Thomas Street Exit, enter the Director’s Office, which is Jesse’s office. Jesse’s Notes To Self is on the white couch to the right.

title: A Letter From Emily Pope To The Director
how: A Letter From Emily Pope To The Director is on the bookshelf near the desk in Jesse’s office, in the same room as Jesse’s Notes To Self.

title: Notes on <redacted>
how: After the credits, go to the P6 Containment section. Notes on <redacted> is in the room next to the couch.

title: Medical Report On The Director
how: After the credits, return to the street entrance of the Oldest House. Medical Report On The Director is on top of a table.

title: Incident Report: Jesse and Dylan Faden
how: After the credits, go to the P6 Containment section. Incident Report: Jesse and Dylan Faden is on top of an equipment rack, in the same section as Notes on <redacted>.

title: Medical Report
how: After you leave the P6 Holding, you reach a security checkpoint with two offices at Executive Research. The Medical Report is on the console in the first checkpoint office.

title: A Memo On Dylan Faden
how: The memo is in the second checkpoint office at Executive Research, right next to the office with the Medical Report.

title: Containment Guard Note
how: Go through the security checkpoint into the open, red-lit area. The note is on one of the bunk beds in the shelter between the elevator to Central Executive and the locked Clearance Level SR door.

title: Written Warning
how: One of the green FBC container rooms is on ground level just southwest of the Oldest House. The Written Warning is on the table inside.

title: Binding Resonants
how: Complete Welcome to Manhattan at the Central Field Office to get the Security Level 01 keycard. Take the fast travel door at the Field Office back into the Oldest House. On the same level as the fast travel door, open the door that needs Security Level 01. Binding Resonants is on the main desk to the left.

title: Psych Eval: Dylan Faden
how: The Psych Eval is in the same Security Level 01 office as Binding Resonants, on the desk near the entrance.

title: Notes On The Ordinary AWE Case File
how: The game starts with Dylan, Jesse’s brother from the first Control game, waking up in his surveillance chamber in P6 Holding. Before you leave the Oldest House, Notes On The Ordinary AWE Case File is on the floor between the chamber and the couch.

title: A Photo of Dylan and Jesse
how: A Photo of Dylan and Jesse is in the same room as Notes On The Ordinary AWE Case File, on the coffee table in P6 Holding.

title: Dimensional Research: Slide Repairs
how: Before you leave the Oldest House through the Thomas Street Exit, go to Jesse’s office, the Director’s Office. Dimensional Research: Slide Repairs is on her desk, next to Jesse’s ID (Jesse Faden).

title: Hugo Stamp
how: During the story quest The House in Distress, you enter the Level 18 Security area Prime Candidate Training, the same area as the Prime Candidate Program collectibles. At the first checkpoint, go into the security office. Hugo Stamp is on top of a table.

title: Neil Hosenberg
how: Go into the room next to the security office at the first checkpoint. Neil Hosenberg is at the messaging tubes.

title: Letter From Grandma
how: During the mission Rebuild, Dylan relives his past in a top-down 2D pixel art game. Letter From Grandma is in the mailbox of Dylan’s house. Once Dylan is out of the game, the letter is in your Archives.

title: A Fantastic Opportunity
quest: Contain the Crisis – Welcome to Manhattan
how: This log plays automatically during the game’s intro, after you defeat the Artist boss.

title: Falling Short
how: This log plays after you complete the story quest Enemy of My Enemy and goes straight into your Archives.

title: Perfect
how: Restore power in the Interactions Lab and this video starts playing.

title: A Weapon
how: Enter one of the upper rooms in Director Training and this video plays. The Prime Candidate Program letter P6 Behavior & Testing is on the desk right next to it.

title: Volatile Paranatural Entity
how: There is a meeting room on the upper floor of Director Training. This video starts playing when you get close to the front screen.

title: Smart Boy
how: Dylan and Zoe cross the Classrooms to reach the Main Test Chamber. This video is playing in the first classroom on the right.

title: Extraordinary Individual
how: This video is added to your Archives when Dylan goes through the Level 18 Security door into Prime Candidate Training in the Oldest House, as part of the main story.

title: Something Innate
how: During Rebuild, Dylan relives his past in a top-down pixel art section, the same one that holds the Ordinary AWE collectible Letter From Grandma. Once the section ends, this video plays.

title: All I Had
how: Complete the main story. Back in Dylan’s Apartment, this recording is by the door.

title: More Qualified
how: After you finish the game, start Game+ by interacting with the mural in the Gap. This video plays right after the opening credits.

title: Failure
how: In Game+, complete the story quest Enemy of My Enemy and this video plays.

title: P6 Is…
how: In Game+, complete The Hedron Link, which ends in a 2D pixel art section. When that section is done, you get this video.

title: Lost Cause
how: In Game+, defeat the Hedron in Fight the Core at the end of the game. This entry is added to your Archives automatically.

title: Just The One
how: Play the whole story again in Game+. After the credits, Dylan is back in his apartment, and the last Dr. Darling video is right by the entrance.

title: Intake Summary
how: One of the upper rooms in the Interactions Lab is an examination room. Intake Summary is on the floor next to the bed.

title: Afraid To Hit, Afraid To Get Hit
how: On the way through the Classrooms to the Main Test Chamber, enter the Playroom, the first classroom on the left. Afraid To Hit, Afraid To Get Hit is on the table.

title: Unrealized Potential
how: Restore power to the Interactions Lab. Unrealized Potential is on the table next to the Perfect video.

title: Psychic Endurance Test
how: Go upstairs in the Interactions Lab. Psychic Endurance Test is on the table in the room with the camera.

title: Institutionalization
how: Institutionalization is on the ground floor of the Interactions Lab, near the room with the speakers.

title: A Worthy Candidate
how: A Worthy Candidate is in the center of the Interactions Lab, on top of the round table.

title: The Director And Diplomacy
how: There is a meeting room on the upper floor of Director Training. The Director And Diplomacy is on the table.

title: On P6’s Potential
how: Dylan and Zoe cross the Classrooms to reach the Main Test Chamber. On P6’s Potential is on the desk in the Playroom, the first classroom on the left.

title: Summary of Prime Candidates
how: After the first checkpoint in Prime Candidate Training, Summary of Prime Candidates is on top of one of the tables near the sliced brain exhibit.

title: Faden Residence
how: Restore power to the Interactions Lab and head upstairs. Faden Residence is at the entrance of a small room with mannequins and a power upgrade box.

title: Jigsaw Puzzle Experiment
how: On the way through the Classrooms to the Main Test Chamber, enter the first classroom on the right, where Dr. Darling’s Smart Boy video is playing. Jigsaw Puzzle Experiment is on the desk.

title: Selection Criteria
how: Selection Criteria is on the main front desk at Main Observation.

title: The TAD Course
how: The TAD Course is on the ground floor of Director Training, lying on the floor in front of the room with the books.

title: P6 Behavior & Testing
how: P6 Behavior & Testing is in one of the upper rooms of Director Training, on the desk next to Dr. Darling’s video A Weapon.

title: P6 & Roberts: A Transcript
place: High Risk Chamber, Prime Candidate Training
how: Leave the Interactions Lab towards the High Risk Chamber. In the first room, a door leads to a small monitoring room with P6 & Roberts: A Transcript inside.

title: A Glimpse
how: Restore power to the Interactions Lab and head upstairs. A Glimpse is in the room with the pile of clocks.

title: Notes On The MCD
how: On the ground floor of Director Training is a room with a red phone. Notes On The MCD is in front of this room, next to the mailing tubes.

title: Objects Of Power
place: High Risk Chamber, Prime Candidate Training
how: Enter the High Risk Chamber area from the Interactions Lab. Objects Of Power is on top of a table in the first room behind the massive door.

title: Andrew Laine Log 1
how: In the entrance hall of Prime Candidate Training, enter the room next to the security checkpoint office. Andrew Laine Log 1 is on top of a table at the far side of the room.

title: Andrew Laine Log 2
how: Upstairs in the Interactions Lab is a room full of monitors, with a door to a staged lounge. Andrew Laine Log 2 is right by the monitors.

title: Andrew Laine Log 3
place: High Risk Chamber, Prime Candidate Training
how: Enter the High Risk Chamber area from the Interactions Lab. Andrew Laine Log 3 is to the right of the massive door.

title: Andrew Laine Log 4
how: Andrew Laine Log 4 is lying on the floor in Main Observation.

title: Andrew Laine Log 5
how: Andrew Laine Log 5 is on the upper floor of Director Training, by the pipes next to the target practice room.

title: Termination Report
how: Termination Report is on the upper floor of Director Training, on the other side of target practice.

title: Say What
how: Say What is your reward for the main quest Evacuation Procedures in the Evac Building at the Evacuation Zone. The song unlocks at the end of the quest, when you escape the building.

title: Another World
how: Another World by Frida Amundsen and Sakima unlocks when you complete the story quest Into the Sinkhole. The Sinkhole is also where the Underpass Accounts collectibles start.

title: No Chains Can Last Forever
how: During the main story quest Search for Jesse, you head into the West Incursion Zone, home of the West Incursion Records collectibles. Right after you find Jesse, Zoe contacts Dylan and plays No Chains Can Last Forever, which keeps you company on the climb up the vertical parking.

title: Fight For Control (We Go To War)
quest: The Hedron Link – Sever the Hedron Links
how: After the main story quest The Hedron Link, Dylan can reach the rooftops of the Unknown by jumping down from Poe’s balloon. Fight For Control (We Go To War) by Heviteemu starts playing as he jumps.

title: A World I’m Ready To Live And Die For
how: During the main story quest Rebuild, Dylan relives his childhood in a top-down pixel art game, the same memory where you find Letter From Grandma for the Ordinary AWE collectibles. Once you complete Rebuild, Zoe contacts Dylan and plays A World I’m Ready To Live And Die For by Costee and Frida Amundsen.

title: Manalan Mailla
how: Manalan Mailla by Vilma Jää is the last song on Zoe’s Mixtape. It unlocks when you finish the main story of Control Resonant.

title: A Note To Mom
how: During the story quest Evacuation Procedures, you follow the Source of the Tremors into the Evac Building. On the 15th floor, the note is lying on one of the stretchers in the evacuation area.

title: Dead Letter: RSVP
how: East of the Oldest House is an unnamed subway station. Head inside and burn the Mold barrier below with Dylan’s Inferno ability. This is the ability door that shows on the map at the checkpoint. The letter is at the far end of the subway platform.

title: Dead Letter: Sasquatch
how: In the west of the West Incursion Zone is a map marker that reads Singing Reported. The subway entrance there is surrounded by Mold. Head down and burn the Mold barrier with Inferno. On the platform, the letter is lying on top of the Mold at the bottom of the stairs.

title: A Note About A Beautiful Dog
how: This note is on the same platform as Dead Letter: Sasquatch, on the opposite side.

title: Missing Dog
how: During the side story Urban Survival, Dylan enters an apartment building in the northeast of the Evacuation Zone to rescue Granny. You can listen to this recording in the hallway of the apartment building.

title: Influencer’s Notebook
how: West of the Oldest House is an area of Dense Patterning. Just south of the Gravity Town Fast Travel Door, inside the Dense Patterning (unscouted) map marker, a person is hovering next to a blue dumpster. They dropped this notebook.

title: The Great Copy Battle
how: This page is inside an Atlantis coffee shop east of the Central Field Office. The shop is between the Field Office Station and Patterned Factory and the East Park Station.

title: Survivalist’s Log
how: The log is on the ground floor of the Survivalist’s bunker, in the room that looks like a cafeteria. This door only opens during the side story Urban Survival, so grab the log while you are there.

title: Note From Civilian Looking for Bitsy
how: This note is inside the Könstig gallery in the southwest of the Park.

title: Customer Complaint
how: This complaint is on the ground in front of the vendor truck in Downtown.

title: SHÜM!!!!!!!
how: Near the Empire Avenue Fast Travel Door in the West Incursion Zone is a barricaded restaurant with a Shüm arcade challenge inside. Break through the entrance to find this document next to the arcade machine.

title: Missing Camera Note
how: This note is inside a barricaded Atlantis coffee shop south of the Laundromat Path to Sinkhole. One of the Evacuation Zone Freeze Frame cameras is just above this shop.

title: Birder’s Note #1
how: There is a Könstig gallery in the northwest of the West Incursion Zone. The note is on the bench inside.

title: Birder’s Note #2
how: This note is on the upside-down roof north of the Parking Garage in the northwest of the West Incursion Zone. It is just below the Street Crossing Freeze Frame camera.

title: Birder’s Note #3
how: Once you have Shift, which unlocks after the Finding Jesse – Incursion Fault story quest, use it to reach the laser alley above the ice cream vendor. The note is on top of a box.

title: Birder’s Note #4
how: In the northeast of the West Incursion Zone, a dead person next to the vertical road is holding this note.

title: Taxi Receipt
how: Complete the side story The Last Taxi to get this taxi receipt as the completion reward.

title: Letter To NYC Newsfeed
how: South of the Central Field Office and southwest of Perimeter Station is a dead end. The red building by the dead end has a terrace with a yellow and blue umbrella. Cross over from the building to the east, and the letter is right underneath the umbrella.

title: Patterned Note
place: Urban Fresh Mart, Factory Island (Unknown Zone)
how: This note is inside the Urban Fresh Mart on Factory Island.

title: After Action Report
how: The After Action Report is in the backroom of a laundromat northeast of the Oldest House in Downtown.

title: Operations Directive
how: Jump over the wall at Lookout Point on the map to reach the Deserted Area east of Downtown. Head down to the abandoned checkpoint. The Operations Directive is on the ground floor, next to a victim.

title: AWE Summaries
how: Past the Southeast Gate in the southeast of Central is a small checkpoint with two offices, one on the ground floor and one on top of it. Open the ground floor office with the Security Level 2 Keycard. Inside is a charged electric cube. Transport its electricity to the entrance of the upper office, where the AWE Summaries are on the desk.

title: Letter To A Colleague
how: Letter To A Colleague is behind the Security Level 2 door on the top level of the Central Executive. You get the keycard during the Evacuation Procedures story quest, after you help Arish escape with the elevator (see the Evacuation Efforts Collectibles). Lockdown Stress (6) is behind the same door, so you can grab both in one go.

title: Complaint Letter
how: On your way from the P6 Holding Cell, the Complaint Letter is on a lit desk right after the security checkpoint.

title: Lockdown Stress
how: Lockdown Stress is in the same room as Letter To A Colleague (4), behind the Security Level 2 door on the top level of the Central Executive.

title: Incident Report: HRAs
how: At the Central Field Office, look for the Staging Lab with the Security Level 1 lock. The Incident Report: HRAs is inside.

title: Baker’s HR Complaints
quest: Welcome to Manhattan – Move the Charge to the Central Checkpoint
how: During Move the Charge to the Central Checkpoint, check inside both checkpoint rooms. Baker’s HR Complaints are on a desk in the southern checkpoint room. The northern room has Baker’s Hiss Complaint from the FBC Logistics collectibles, so grab both while you are there.

title: Request: Change of Post
how: The request is on the table at the dead end of the southwestern road in Downtown.

title: Safety Alert: Hiss Spikes
how: Head to the south of the Deserted Area in the east of Downtown. You can cross over at the spot marked Lookout Point. The Safety Alert is on a desk surrounded by Hiss Spikes.

title: Warning
how: Go to the West Supply Route Station entrance in the northwest of Downtown and head downstairs. The Warning is on top of a table in the first room.

title: FBC Policy Update: Security
how: After Welcome to Manhattan you own Security Keycard 01. Use it on the bottom door of the Security Station at the Central Field Office. The FBC Policy Update is on the table inside.

title: Notice To Supervisors
how: In the center of Downtown, east of the vendor, is a crossroads with a checkpoint. Notice To Supervisors is in the ground floor room.

title: Langston’s Beat Poetry #27
how: This poetry draft is at the Central Field Office, right next to the Field Panopticon station where you can talk to an “Important Person”.

title: Note On The Furnace Chamber
how: On the road to the Central Checkpoint, east of the Oldest House, is a big checkpoint with four container rooms. The note is in the northern top floor room.

title: FBC Welcome Letter
how: Complete the story quest Power Lines and save Dr. Florez and the survivors in the subway. She then joins the Field Office, and the FBC Welcome Letter is on a table just underneath the Field Hospital.

title: Encounter Report: Strange Dog
how: The report is on the top level of the building north of the Perimeter Station and east of the Field Office.

title: Hiss Brief
how: The Hiss Brief is in a ground level garage protected by Hiss lasers, at the back of the big red brick building in this part of Central.

title: Guidelines To Accessing The Sinkhole
how: You need to enter the Sinkhole for the story quest Recursions and Iterations and the side story Into the Valley of Death. These guidelines are at the security checkpoint at the Laundromat.

title: Sinkhole Transcript
how: The transcript is in the first area after you exit the Evacuation Zone Checkpoint coming from Central.

title: FBC Subway Report
how: This recording is right next to the Map Kit Antenna and its fast travel door in the Evacuation Zone.

title: PR Guidance Re: Patterned Subway Tunnels
how: In front of the Evac Building is an elevated, orange container. The PR Guidance is inside on the desk. The Evac Building is also where you find most of the Evacuation Efforts collectibles.

title: Status Enquiry
quest: Welcome to Manhattan – Clear the Supply Route
how: Reach the Watchtower and talk to Zoe. She gives you the key to the Underground Supply Lines elevator. The Status Enquiry is on a desk at the bottom of the elevator.

title: Investigation Order
how: The Investigation Order is in front of a parking garage in the southwest of the Evacuation Zone, where the map shows Unauthorized Mines. Reading it starts the Urban Survival side story.

title: Ranger’s Stakeout Notes
how: These notes are on the roof opposite the parking garage with the Unauthorized Mines from the Urban Survival side story.

title: Patterned Supply Distribution Check List
how: This Patterned document is on the main desk at Field Office Command in the Unknown.

title: Evacuation Intake Form
how: The Evacuation Intake Form is on the table in front of the Evac Building entrance in the Evacuation Zone.

title: Evacuation Pamphlet
how: Go inside the Evac Building. The Evacuation Pamphlet is on a desk near the reception desk on the ground floor.

title: Mission Notes 1
how: Mission Notes 1 are on top of a box near the Evac Building entrance.

title: Mission Notes 2
how: This is probably the last Evacuation Efforts document you can collect. After you help Arish escape with the elevator, you own the Security Level 2 Keycard. Open the top door in the big staircase room on the 12th floor of the Evac Building to find Mission Notes 2.

title: Mission Notes 3
quest: Evacuation Procedures – Find the Source of the Tremors
how: During Find the Source of the Tremors on the 12th floor of the Evac Building, Dylan reaches a corridor with dead civilians hovering in it and reports back to Zoe. He then relives a piece of this past in the Oldest House. After this segment, back on the 12th floor, follow the red cord to a Hiss inside a room. Mission Notes 3 are in this room.

title: Mission Notes 4
how: Reach the 15th floor of the Evac Building. Mission Notes 4 are in the evacuation area on this floor.

title: An Internal FBC Comms Department Letter
how: Head to the 12th floor of the Evac Building. In the big room with staircases to the left and right, one of the passages is lit in blue. Follow it to the scaffolding at the end and traverse to the right, following the light. It leads to a room at the bottom of the scaffolding with a loot box and the letter on top of a table.

title: Formal Complaint
how: The Formal Complaint is in the corridor of the Evacuation Zone Checkpoint at Central.

title: PR Video Screenplay
how: In front of the Evac Building is a small container on the ground floor that you can enter. The PR Video Screenplay is on the shelf inside.

title: Daily Comms Log
how: In front of the Evac Building is an elevated, orange container. The Daily Comms Log is inside on the computer desk.

title: Aberrant
how: This document only appears after the credits. Visit the P6 Containment section in the Oldest House, where Aberrant is on the table in the darker part of the room.

title: Notes On The Board
how: Finish Welcome to Manhattan at the Central Field Office to get the Security Level 01 keycard. Take the fast travel door at the Field Office back into the Oldest House. On the same level as the fast travel door, open the Security Level 01 door. Notes On The Board are on the coffee table to the left.

title: Sound Bath Sterilization Study
how: Go to the 12th floor of the Evac Building in the Evacuation Zone, the same floor as several Evacuation Efforts collectibles. The study is in one of the cubicles in the computer room.

title: Hiss Spikes
how: In the southwest of Downtown, head south from the vendor to a dead end covered in Hiss Spikes. The report is on the table there.

title: ShenyangIMC Door (AI2294-UE)
how: The file is on the floor next to the fast travel door at the Central Field Office.

title: Orientation Points
how: West of the Central Field Office is a Patterned Road. Use Shift on it to reach the table in the middle of the road, where you find the report.

title: Volatile Floating Hiss
how: Enter the Evac Building in the Evacuation Zone and take the small corridor to the right. The report is on top of a desk.

title: Hiss Imposters
how: Go to the building north of the Perimeter Station and east of the Central Field Office. The report is on the ground floor inside.

title: Field Notes: Pattern Anomalies
how: East of the House of Mirrors in the West Incursion Zone is a construction site with three floors. Head down to the bottom floor, where a minefield waits around the desk with the field notes. For more documents in this area, see the West Incursion Records collectibles.

title: The Hot Dog Incident
unlocks: Hot dog conversation in the Evacuation Zone
how: The report is on one of the tables in the Watchtower, in the same room as Zoe. If it is not there yet, travel to the Survivalist’s Bunker in the south of the Evacuation Zone, the area from the Urban Survival side story. Walk around near the hot dog food trucks to trigger a conversation between Dylan and Zoe about hot dogs. Afterwards, the report shows up in the Watchtower.

title: FBC Injury And Accident Report
how: Complete Enemy of My Enemy. The report then appears on the center command desk at the Central Field Office.

title: Fra Containment Report
how: Complete the A New Directive side story and put Fra in the containment unit next to Langston at the Central Field Office. Come back later to find the report near Langston.

title: Acoustic Testing & Observations
how: After the main quest The Hedron Link, Dylan can reach the rooftop of the Oldest House. The document is up there.

title: Research Notes: The Former
how: There is a second Security Level 01 door on the same level as the Oldest House fast travel door, near the Executive Affairs corridor. The notes are on the desk inside.

title: Dimensional Faults
how: This document shows up at the Thomas Street exit of the Oldest House after Rebuild, once all Probe Relays in the Unknown are set up.

title: The Nature Of Hedrons
unlocks: Defeat the Hedron in the story
how: Defeat the Hedron in the story, then return to the Central Field Office Command to find this report.

title: Power Core Complaint
how: The complaint is next to the rooftop power core. Pick it up while you move the charge to the Central Checkpoint in Welcome to Manhattan.

title: Power Core Servicing Diagram
how: Head to the checkpoint in the southeast of Downtown, on the border to the Deserted Area. The diagram is on the table at the back.

title: Baker’s Hiss Complaint
how: During Welcome to Manhattan – Move the Charge to the Central Checkpoint, check inside both checkpoint rooms. The complaint is on a desk in the northern room. The southern room has a Crisis Containment document, so grab that while you are there.

title: A Note From Baker
how: The note is at the same southeast checkpoint on the border to the Deserted Area as the Power Core Servicing Diagram. It is on a chair.

title: Radar Report
how: East of the Central Checkpoint is a small courtyard surrounded by Pattern Barriers. The report is on the desk there.

title: Black Rock Mines
how: The report is at the checkpoint in the south of Downtown, near the Deserted Area.

title: Supply Distribution Check List
how: The check list is on one of the desks near the Central Field Office entrance.

title: Balloon Deployment
how: Outside, but still on the Field Office grounds, is a small testing area with an orange tarp and orange balloons. The briefing is on the tarp.

title: Field Office Note
how: The note is in the same balloon testing area as Balloon Deployment, on top of an FBC box.

title: Maintenance Report On the NSC
how: The report is behind one of the Security Level 06 doors at Central Executive. To get the keycard, head to the Park and follow the New Growth side story. It sends you to a Research Site in the south of the Park, where you pick up Dr. Underhill’s Resignation Letter. The keycard comes with the letter. Once you have the keycard, open the Security Level 06 door. The report is on the desk in the room.

title: The FBC’s Funding
how: The document is in the elevated office behind Field Office Command and the Cafeteria.

title: Maintenance Recording #1
how: Head down to Perimeter Station in the northeast of the Central district. Maintenance Recording #1 is on one of the benches on the platform by the trains.

title: Maintenance Recording #2
how: Maintenance Recording #2 is on the same Perimeter Station platform as Maintenance Recording #1, over by the tracks.

title: Maintenance Recording #3
how: Head down to Factory Station in the center of the Central district. Maintenance Recording #3 is on one of the benches on the platform by the trains.

title: Maintenance Recording #4
how: Maintenance Recording #4 is on the same Factory Station platform as Maintenance Recording #3, just further back.

title: Maintenance Recording #5
how: Head down to East Park Station in the east of the Central district. Maintenance Recording #5 is on one of the benches down on the platform.

title: Maintenance Recording #6
how: Maintenance Recording #6 is on the same East Park Station platform as Maintenance Recording #5, on the floor next to the stairs.

title: Maintenance Recording #7
quest: Power Lines – Reroute the Vanished Station
how: After you activate all three power stations, every subway station entrance is blocked and Dylan has to find another way to the surface. Follow the train tracks past the spot where a big turbine blocked the way before, which is now gone. The tracks lead to the Vanished Station. Head upstairs to find Maintenance Recording #7 in the corridor.

title: Maintenance Recording #8
quest: Power Lines – Reroute the Vanished Station
how: Maintenance Recording #8 is down on the Vanished Station platform.

title: Maintenance Recording #9
quest: Power Lines – Reroute the Vanished Station
how: In the upper part of the Vanished Station is a flood light with mold that keeps growing while the light is on. Hit the electric cube and run to the nearby shop that also has a cube, then transfer the power to it. The shutters open and Maintenance Recording #9 is inside.

title: Clarke’s ID Badge
quest: Power Lines – Head to the Surface
how: After you activate all three power stations and the subway station entrances are blocked, follow the train tracks past the spot where the big turbine used to block the way. There is a corpse in the corridor. Interact with it to pick up Clarke’s ID Badge.

title: Zone Conditions
how: Complete the Welcome to Manhattan quest to get the Security Level 1 Keycard. It unlocks the small office next to the personnel entrance of the Central Field Office. Zone Conditions is on the desk, next to a loot box.

title: Pattern Barrier
how: In the center of Downtown, east of the vendor, is a crossroads with a checkpoint. Go up to the room on the top floor of the checkpoint to find the Pattern Barrier report.

title: Incident Report: Pattern Barrier
how: South of the Central Field Office, at the personnel entrance, is a Konstig Gallery with a Security Level 2 lock. You get the keycard when you complete the main quest Evacuation Procedures (see the Evacuation Efforts Collectibles). The Incident Report: Pattern Barrier is inside the gallery.

title: Notes On Pattern Victims
how: Complete the story quest Power Lines and save the survivors and Dr. Florez in the subway (all 10 Subway Maintenance Collectibles are on the same quest). Dr. Florez then joins the Field Office and writes this report. Notes On Pattern Victims is in front of the ER Medical Unit.

title: Notes On Ambient Patterning
how: Notes On Ambient Patterning is the second document Dr. Florez writes once Dylan has saved her during Power Lines. It is on one of the desks below the Field Hospital, so you can pick it up together with Notes On Pattern Victims (4).

title: Resonant Autopsy
how: In the western part of the Central Field Office is a small checkpoint in the road. The Resonant Autopsy is on the table there.

title: Observations Report
how: The Observations Report appears at the Central Field Office, in the same spot as the other Resonant reports, once you have defeated two Resonants.

title: Field Research On Resonant Entity: RE-ZD
how: The research on RE-ZD is in the main room on the ground floor of the Central Field Office.

title: Field Research On Resonant Entity: RE-WIZ
unlocks: Defeat the Resonant in the West Incursion Zone
how: Defeat the Resonant at the dance hall in the West Incursion Zone (the West Incursion Records Collectibles are in the same zone). Then return to the Central Field Office. The report is on one of the desks in the Command room.

title: Field Research On Resonant Entity: RE-ZC
unlocks: Defeat the Resonant in the Patterned Factory
how: Defeat the Resonant in the Patterned Factory in Central. Then return to the Central Field Office. The report is on one of the desks in the Command room.

title: Field Research On Resonant Entity: RE-TP
unlocks: Defeat the Resonant in The Park
how: Defeat the Resonant in The Park. Then return to the Central Field Office. The report is on one of the desks in the Command room.

title: Field Research On Resonant Entity: RE-UN
unlocks: Defeat the Resonant at the Spire in the Underpass
how: Defeat the Resonant at the Spire in the Underpass. Then return to the Central Field Office. The report is in the Command room.

title: Field Research On Resonant Entity: RE-UZ
unlocks: Defeat the Resonant in the Unknown Zone
how: Defeat the Resonant at the Field Office in the Unknown Zone. You find the report later in the Command room of the Central Field Office.

title: Medical Recommendation
how: The Medical Recommendation is usually the last Simon Arish collectible you find. Zoe contacts Dylan to tell him someone dropped off a document about Arish at the Watchtower, and it is then on the desk next to Zoe. For me, it showed up after completing the Notes objective Defeat the Resonant Entities (see the Resonant Entities Collectibles), with the other three Simon Arish collectibles already picked up and every Important Person on the map talked to.

title: Arish On Morale
how: Complete the story quest Evacuation Procedures to receive the Level 2 Keycard (see the Evacuation Efforts Collectibles). Arish On Morale is on the main desk behind the Level 02 Security door, next to the Oldest House: Central Executive fast travel door.

title: Arish’s Note
how: Arish’s Note only appears once you have completed the main story. Head back to the Central Field Office and you find it on the center command desk.

title: Arish’s Private Log
how: Arish’s Private Log is part of the quest The Unknown Resonant. You find it on the main desk at Field Office Command in the Unknown district.

title: Injury Report: Factory Accident
how: The Injury Report: Factory Accident is just below the Field Hospital at the Central Field Office. It is on one of the desks in the little office area.

title: City Maintenance Observations
how: Take the elevator down in the Patterned Factory and go past the Fast Travel Door. Climb the long staircase, turn around at the top and take the right side tunnel between the two pipes. Keep to the right to reach a dead end room with a loot box and two dead maintenance workers. One of them carries the City Maintenance Observations.

title: Factory Log #1
how: Go back to the save point in the corridor with the pipes and turn left this time. Factory Log #1 is on a table there.

title: Factory Log #2
how: From Factory Log #1, follow the tunnel to a room full of Hiss. A big pipe blocks one of the corridors. Jump over it to find two tables at the end of the corridor, with Factory Log #2 on one of them.

title: Factory Log #3
how: Go back to the big staircase and take the left side tunnel between the two pipes. Find the room with the health upgrade box, where Dylan can report a Makeshift Living Space. Factory Log #3 is on the table next to it.

title: An Old Journal
how: An Old Journal is in the same room as Factory Log #3, on the other table.

title: FBC ID Badge
how: The FBC ID Badge only appears after you defeat the Deserter, the lava Resonant inside the Patterned Factory. It is lying on the round floor, in the same spot where the Deserter falls.

title: Operations Recommendation
how: Complete the quest Welcome to Manhattan to receive the Security Keycard 01. With it, you can unlock the top Security Station door at the Central Field Office. The Operations Recommendation is on the desk inside.

title: West Incursion Zone Checkpoint Memo
how: The West Incursion Zone Checkpoint Memo is in the corridor of the West Incursion Zone Checkpoint, between Central and the West Incursion Zone.

title: Shanower’s Recon Report
how: Enter the West Incursion Zone through the checkpoint coming from Central and follow the road as far as it goes. From there, use the Switch ability to follow the dotted line on the map. Shanower’s Recon Report is on the floor on top of a roof.

title: Shanower’s Final Report
place: Empire Avenue Station, West Incursion Zone
how: Shanower’s Final Report is the hardest one to find if you don’t stumble upon it by accident. Follow the annotations on the in-game map. The recording is just below the “E” of Empire Avenue Station, on the ground floor in a dark alley.

title: Parking Garage Attendant’s Report
how: In the story quest The Incursion Fault, you have to find the key for the Parking Garage entrance door. A note says the attendant is either at the Laundromat or having a smoke out back. Enter the Laundromat through the back door to find the security guard with the Parking Garage Attendant’s Report on the floor.

title: West Incursion Zone Observations
how: In the quest The West Incursion Zone Resonant, Dylan follows the tracks of an FBC rescue team to a subway station. The West Incursion Zone Observations are on the floor at the subway entrance.

title: Dance Hall Investigation
how: Keep following the rescue team towards the Resonant’s location. Dylan reports a massive blood mural to Zoe. The Dance Hall Investigation recording is on the floor right there.

title: Streamer’s Archive
how: Right before the fight against the West Incursion Zone Resonant, Dylan is in the dance hall with the green seating rows. The Streamer’s Archive recorder is at the bottom of the rows.

title: Werewolf Reinforcements
place: House of Mirrors, West Incursion Zone
how: The Werewolf Reinforcements report is inside the House of Mirrors in the West Incursion Zone, near the Player Customization box.

title: Physicist’s Log #1
how: Physicist’s Log #1 is right next to The Spire Fast Travel door in the Underpass.

title: Physicist’s Log #2
how: On the way to the Underpass Resonant, get past the blocked passage with the spiked floor fight. After the Board, the strange voice that follows Dylan around, speaks to him, Physicist’s Log #2 is on the floor.

title: Physicist’s Log #3
how: Reach the corridor with the door and go to the pillar on the left of the door. Follow the red floor to a room with an Astral Key mission marker. Physicist’s Log #3 is next to the TV, in the same room as A Collections Letter.

title: Physicist’s Log #4
how: Physicist’s Log #4 is behind the locked door in the door corridor. You open it with an Astral Key from one of the three pillars around the corridor.

title: Physicist’s Log #5
how: This is one of the hardest ones to find. Go to the pillar at the far end of the door corridor and climb to its highest point, where a couple of corridors branch off. Look for the shift downward that takes you onto the ceiling. Physicist’s Log #5 is in a dark area with a TV. The Astral Key box is on the other side of this area, also on the ceiling.

title: Physicist’s Log #6
how: Physicist’s Log #6 is in the same area as the Investigate the Astral Plane mission marker, where you get an Astral Key, next to the bedroom with the four loot boxes.

title: Physicist’s Log #7
how: Collect the three Astral Keys from the three pillars around the door corridor and open the three doors, one after the other. They lead to the Physicist’s apartment. Physicist’s Log #7 is on the table to the right, together with the Rejection Letter.

title: Physicist’s Log #8
how: Physicist’s Log #8 drops after you defeat the Physicist, the Underpass Resonant.

title: A Collections Letter
how: Reach the corridor with the door and go to the pillar on the left of the door. Follow the red floor to the room with an Astral Key mission marker. A Collections Letter is on the desk, in the same room as Physicist’s Log #3.

title: Letter From Howie
how: Letter From Howie is on the left side table in the Physicist’s apartment.

title: Rejection Letter
how: Rejection Letter is on the right side table in the Physicist’s apartment, together with Physicist’s Log #7.

title: Astral Plane Observations
how: After you defeat the Physicist, Astral Plane Observations is at the entrance to the Oldest House in Downtown.

title: The Mold
how: There is an old, overgrown checkpoint between Central and the Park. The way in is a Mold-packed checkpoint elevator in the northeast of Central, east of the Central Vendor. The Mold report is in the checkpoint corridor.

title: A Note On Rules
how: A Note On Rules is in the corridor of the Park Checkpoint in the northeast of Central.

title: Notes On The New Mold Strains
how: Once you have found the new Mold strains nearby during the Park Resonant quest, these notes are at the FBC Base, next to the Ranger you can talk to.

title: Research Notes On The Mold
how: In the side story New Growth, you get the key to Dr. Raya Underhill’s apartment in the northeast of the Park. The research notes are inside. The rest of the New Growth documents are in the Dr. Raya Underhill collectibles guide.

title: Research Memo
how: The Research Memo is on one of the tables at the FBC Base. You have to read it to move the Park Resonant quest forward.

title: A Farewell Note
how: During the Park Resonant quest, Dylan has to eat four pieces of Delicious Mold to open the Mold Gate. A Farewell Note is behind the gate, next to a corpse.

title: Resonant Entity Report (The Park)
how: This report only appears after you defeat the Park Resonant. Go to the small lab on street level just below the FBC Base and talk to the lab assistant. Tell them there was a Mold Resonant and things should be quieter now. The assistant then writes the Resonant Entity Report, which you find at the back of the same lab.

title: An Angry Note
how: An Angry Note is also at the FBC Base, on the rooftop towards the east. Use Ground Slam on the ability door on the roof to get inside. The note is in the same room as the Player Customization Box.

title: Letter To Hannah
how: During the side story Carbon Copy, the Letter To Hannah is on the coffee table in Hannah’s apartment.

title: Medical Report: Hannah Garrett
how: The Medical Report is in the ER Medical Unit at the Central Field Office. You can only pick it up during Carbon Copy Part 2.

title: Note From Heidi
how: The Note From Heidi is in the same ER Medical Unit, on one of the beds.

title: Welcome Letter
how: In the Park side story New Growth, you get the Security Level 6 keycard to Dr. Raya Underhill’s office in Central Executive, Downtown. The Welcome Letter is on the big square desk in the office to the right, together with Dr. Underhill’s Apartment Keys.

title: Underhill’s Personal Notes
how: Underhill’s Personal Notes are on the desk inside Dr. Underhill’s office in Central Executive, the office you open with the Security Level 6 keycard from New Growth. The Welcome Letter and Underhill’s Research Notes are in the same office.

title: Underhill’s Memo
how: East of the FBC Base in the Park, a gym on ground level by the road has been turned into a lab. Underhill’s Memo is inside, in the same lab as Busken’s Note.

title: Response From Pope
how: In New Growth, Dylan finds Dr. Raya Underhill in her apartment, and she hands over the Key to Underhill’s Sewer Lab. Response From Pope is on the table in the Sewer Lab, the same lab as The Mold Growth Simulator.

title: Underhill’s Research Notes
how: Underhill’s Research Notes are in Dr. Underhill’s office in Central Executive, on the back desk of the office on the right, the same office as the Welcome Letter.

title: Underhill’s Hypothesis
how: New Growth leads you to a research site on a roof in the south of the Park. Underhill’s Hypothesis is at this rooftop research site, the same spot as Underhill’s Resignation Letter.

title: The Mold Growth Simulator
how: The Mold Growth Simulator is on the table in Underhill’s Sewer Lab, which you open with the key Dr. Underhill gives Dylan in her apartment during New Growth. Response From Pope is in the same lab.

title: Busken’s Note
how: Busken’s Note is in the gym turned into a lab on ground level east of the FBC Base, the same lab as Underhill’s Memo.

title: Underhill’s Resignation Letter
how: At the rooftop research site in the south of the Park, where New Growth leads you, Underhill’s Resignation Letter is on the table. Underhill’s Hypothesis is at the same research site.

title: Here Be Dragons
how: Here Be Dragons is the first document to find in the Underpass. It is right after entering the Underpass coming from the Sinkhole.

title: In Case Things Go Wrong
how: From the corridor leading into the Underpass in the northeast of the map, where Here Be Dragons is, drop down to a platform with two rows of desks and a save point. In Case Things Go Wrong is on one of the desks.

title: The Sheer Scale Of The Underpass
how: In the story quest Recursions and Iterations, Dylan follows the ropes of Agent Schultz past the Underpass vendor to the next save point. The Sheer Scale Of The Underpass is right there.

title: Blazing A Trail
how: Keep following the rope from The Sheer Scale Of The Underpass. Cross over on the shifting platforms onto a bigger red, square platform with Hiss and defeat them. Then shift onto the ceiling and drop down the square hole in the floor to land on a bigger concrete section. Dylan points out something in the distance and the Underpass Resonant quest activates. Blazing A Trail is on a desk here.

title: Ayad Transmission
how: Ayad Transmission is on the western side of the Underpass location named Research Site on the map. Notes On Team Psychology from the Underpass Exploration collectibles is on the same side.

title: Strange Lights
how: Strange Lights is on the same level as The Spire Fast Travel door, at a small lookout towards the south. Dylan can also report the distant lights to Zoe here.

title: Frequent Disagreements
how: Frequent Disagreements is in the same room as the Player Customization Box at Another Research Site. Grist Research Log #2 from the Underpass Exploration collectibles is in this room too.

title: Everybody’s So Damn Tired
how: Everybody’s So Damn Tired is at the third research site, Another Research Site, in the center area with the researchers, where Dylan meets Dr. Grist in the story quest Recursions and Iterations. The southern office here holds three Underpass Exploration documents, starting with Steinbeck Psychiatry Report #2.

title: Note To Self
how: Note To Self is in the same section near the dead scientists as Everybody’s So Damn Tired, but closer to the stairs.

title: Grist Hiss Recording
quest: Recursions and Iterations – Track the Time Fluctuations
how: Grist Hiss Recording is one of the items that need to be picked up during the Track the Time Fluctuations steps in the story quest Recursions and Iterations.

title: Waste Disposal
how: West of the area named Research Site on the map is …Research Site?. Look for a pile of full garbage bags with Waste Disposal on the floor. Schultz Expedition Log #2 from the Underpass Exploration collectibles is at the same garbage bags.

title: Final Survivor
how: Final Survivor is at …Research Site?, the same research site as Waste Disposal, just below the dead scientists. Several Underpass Exploration collectibles are here too, including Notes On Patterning/Spacetime in the center and Schultz Expedition Log #3 in the office.

title: Scrawled Note
how: Cross the chasm with the cable car to reach Research Site… Again, far east of Research Site. Scrawled Note is in the office with the Character Customization box. Steinbeck Psychiatry Report #3 from the Underpass Exploration collectibles is at this research site too.

title: I Don’t Mind Dying
quest: Recursions and Iterations – Follow the Relays to Grist
how: During the Follow the Relays to Grist step in Recursions and Iterations, Dylan comes across a dead Dylan. I Don’t Mind Dying is next to his body.

title: Grist’s Final Words
quest: Recursions and Iterations – Follow the Relays to Grist
how: Follow the relays Grist has set up in the story quest Recursions and Iterations. When Dylan finds her, she gets killed but leaves Grist’s Final Words behind.

title: Schultz Expedition Log #1
how: Schultz Expedition Log #1 is at The Spire, in the same area as A Half-Filled Form (number 2), a bit further up to the left.

title: A Half-Filled Form
how: Follow the ropes in the story quest Recursions and Iterations to a research area with tents at The Spire, near the Underpass Resonant location. A Half-Filled Form is on the table here.

title: Ayad Engineering Log #1
how: Ayad Engineering Log #1 is just north of the Halfway Trail Fast Travel Door, on top of a computer desk.

title: Grist Research Log #1
how: Grist Research Log #1 is on the southern side of Research Site, in the same room as the Player Customization box.

title: Schultz Expedition Log #2
how: Schultz Expedition Log #2 is at …Research Site?, west of Research Site, near the garbage bags. These are the same garbage bags as Waste Disposal from the Underpass Accounts collectibles, so you can grab both at once.

title: Steinbeck Psychiatry Report #1
how: Steinbeck Psychiatry Report #1 is right next to the research team Dylan finds at Research Site during the story quest Recursions and Iterations.

title: Notes On Team Psychology
how: Notes On Team Psychology is on the western side of Research Site. Ayad Transmission from the Underpass Accounts collectibles is on the same side.

title: Initial Findings
how: Initial Findings is on the southern side of Research Site, close to the Player Customization box.

title: Grist Research Log #2
how: Grist Research Log #2 is at Another Research Site, south of Research Site, in the same room as the Player Customization box. Frequent Disagreements from the Underpass Accounts collectibles is in this room too.

title: Steinbeck Psychiatry Report #2
how: Steinbeck Psychiatry Report #2 is in the southern office at Another Research Site.

title: Unable To Contact Pope
how: Unable To Contact Pope is in the same southern office at Another Research Site as Steinbeck Psychiatry Report #2.

title: Persistent Memory Issues
how: Persistent Memory Issues is the third document in the southern office at Another Research Site.

title: Ayad Engineering Log #2
how: Ayad Engineering Log #2 is at …Research Site?, west of Research Site, in the same room as the Player Customization box.

title: Grist Research Log #3
how: After talking to Dr. Grist at Another Research Site in the story quest Recursions and Iterations, return to …Research Site? in the west. Grist Research Log #3 is on the floor in the center. You have to pick it up to advance the story.

title: Schultz Expedition Log #3
how: Schultz Expedition Log #3 is inside the office on the northern side of …Research Site?.

title: Notes On Patterning/Spacetime
how: Notes On Patterning/Spacetime is in the center of …Research Site?. This is where Dylan finds Schultz first alive, then dead, during the story quest Recursions and Iterations.

title: Morale’s In The Toilet
how: Morale’s In The Toilet is in the same office as Schultz Expedition Log #3.

title: Our Memories Aren’t The Problem
how: Our Memories Aren’t The Problem is also at …Research Site?, in the same room as the Player Customization box and Ayad Engineering Log #2.

title: Steinbeck Psychiatry Report #3
how: Cross the chasm with the cable car to reach Research Site… Again, far east of Research Site. Steinbeck Psychiatry Report #3 is in the center area, where the researchers usually stand. Scrawled Note from the Underpass Accounts collectibles is at this research site too.

title: The Roots Of The Oldest House?
how: After you finish the main story, Zoe calls Dylan to a briefing at the watchtower. This starts the Maintenance Protocol side story. Enter the Oldest House through the door near the sapling in the Underpass. The Roots Of The Oldest House? is in the first lobby room.

title: On the Oldest House’s Form
how: The last Underpass Exploration collectible is just upstairs from The Roots Of The Oldest House?, inside the office with the Power Upgrade box.

title: Field Panopticon Protocol
how: The Field Panopticon Protocol is at the Central Field Office, near the Field Panopticon station where you can talk to an “Important Person”.

title: Processing Altered Items
how: During the side story The Complete Set, Langston gives Dylan the SR keycard for the Oldest House Storage Room. Processing Altered Items is inside the Storage Room.

title: Strip District “Umbrella Guy”
how: Strip District “Umbrella Guy” is in the same Oldest House Storage Room as Processing Altered Items, so you can grab both at once.

title: Vintage Radio (AI94-KPE)
how: Complete the Panopticon Service Request side story, then return later to pick up the Vintage Radio (AI94-KPE) file.

title: Vintage Radio Hypotheses
how: Vintage Radio Hypotheses is the second Vintage Radio file you can pick up after completing the Panopticon Service Request side story.

title: Vintage Radio Supplement
how: Enter the cafeteria at the Central Field Office. Vintage Radio Supplement is on one of the tables.

title: Instant Camera (AI96-KE)
how: Complete the side story Freeze Frame to capture the camera causing trouble across all zones. It is then locked up in the Panopticon, and the Instant Camera (AI96-KE) case file is right next to it.

title: Rogue Item Alert
how: Go up to the outside terrace above the Command Room at the Central Field Office. Rogue Item Alert is on top of a box next to a table.

title: $89.45 Spells HIDE
how: On a bench in the locker room of the Pulse Fitness gym in the south of the zone.

title: There's People In There
how: Recording next to the brown leather armchair/couch on the middle floor, near the unresponsive person. Listening adds the next mission markers.

title: Mysterious Recording
how: On a bench in the ground-floor locker room of the Auction House.

title: The SINKKI D50 Speaker Set
how: Auction House in the northwest of Downtown (Dense Patterning), enter via the roof. On a table by the Orientation Point.

title: Auction House Ledger
how: On a table in the large ground-floor kitchen of the Auction House.

title: Warning Note
place: Museum of Curiosities, West Incursion Zone
how: On the ground behind the Museum of Curiosities front desk.

title: Museum Workers' Notes
place: Museum of Curiosities, West Incursion Zone
how: On top of the Museum of Curiosities front desk, south of the zone. Reading it can start the side story The Complete Set.

title: Noise Complaint
how: On a bedroom table in the Auction Buyer's Apartment.

title: Exchange Location Note
how: Auction Buyer's Apartment, east of the Central Field Office, third floor. On a cabinet by the front door.

title: Auction Purchase Receipt
how: On the ground behind the southeastern Atlantis Cafe.

title: Pete, Nina and Lester
how: Answering machine by the fridge in the Collector's Apartment, second floor, first door on the left.

title: Interested In Collectibles?
how: On the ground at the Collector's Apartment entrance in southwest Central (patterned road west of the Field Office).

title: Museum Flyer
how: In a southern back alley next to a green garbage bin.

title: The SINKKI D50 Speaker Set (AI1201-UE)
how: Same SR storage room in Executive Research. On a crate by a cubicle. Needs Langston's keycard.

title: False SINKKI Lead
how: Executive Research storage room (SR) in the Oldest House. Get the SR keycard from Langston at the Central Field Office. On a small cabinet by the back wall.

title: Auction House setup note (name unconfirmed)
how: Note near the incapacitated person on the Auction House balcony, explaining how to place 4 speakers and 1 subwoofer. Not confirmed as the 16th Altered Speakers entry; check the in-game list.

title: Medic’s Assessment Recording
how: Finish the story mission Welcome to Manhattan to get the Security Level 01 keycard. It lets you into the Field Hospital at the Central Field Office. The Medic’s Assessment Recording is on the table inside.

title: Dig Site Threshold Quarantine List
how: While you are in the Field Hospital, report the person without a head and the locked cabinet to Zoe. Zoe sends you to the Security Station for the cabinet code. The Security Station is in the building on the other side of the Field Hospital and has two Security Level 01 doors. Take the top door and use the computer. Select Next Screen until you see a picture of the cabinet to collect the code. Go back to the Field Hospital and open the cabinet. The Quarantine List is inside.

title: Team Lead’s Expedition Log
how: Head to the Threshold Dig Site northwest of the Central Field Office. The Team Lead’s Expedition Log is on the bottom floor. TE Keycard Location – Mobile Research Station Access Needed for: 4 – Threshold Site Recording and 7 – Dig Site Threshold Note Location: Threshold Dig Site, Central The TE Keycard opens the Mobile Research Station at the Threshold Dig Site, where 2 of the Dig Site Threshold collectibles are. Report the headless person at the Threshold Dig Site to Zoe, then pick up the TE Keycard from the person’s hand.

title: Threshold Site Recording
how: Use the TE Keycard to open the Mobile Research Station at the Threshold Dig Site. The Threshold Site Recording is right by the entrance.

title: Wilson’s ID Badge
how: Report the white lab coat next to the headless body to Zoe. Then interact with the lab coat again to pick up Wilson’s ID Badge.

title: Parabiologist’s Notes
how: The Parabiologist’s Notes are also at the Threshold Dig Site, on a desk on the other side of the area.

title: Dig Site Threshold Note
how: Go back into the Mobile Research Station with the TE Keycard. The Dig Site Threshold Note is on the table at the far end of the room.

title: Dr. Grant’s Voicemail
how: In the south of the West Incursion Zone, use the Patterned Road with Shift to reach the higher rooftops. Look for an empty pizza shop you can enter. There is a dug-out construction hole with a sewer pipe at the bottom. Follow the pipe into the sewers. You have to defeat the Hiss in the first room to move on. At the end of the sewers is Testing Facility Broadway, and Dr. Grant’s Voicemail is on the desk.

title: A Note From Dr. Milbeck’s Cardiologist
how: Reach the Deserted Area in the east of Downtown over the Lookout Point platform. The building site here is full of Hiss. Defeat them all, then look for a square hole in the ground with a pipe down to the sewers. Follow the pipe through the sewers to Testing Facility Reade. The note is in the room at the far back of the higher platform, next to a Power Upgrade box.

title: Testing Facility Coordinates
how: Testing Facility Coordinates is in the same room as A Note From Dr. Milbeck’s Cardiologist. Pick it up early, because it marks all Testing Facilities on your map.

title: Notes From Dr. Janson
how: Dr. Janson’s notes are in the back room of the West Incursion Zone Testing Facility, the same facility as Dr. Grant’s Voicemail. The back room only opens after you shut down the experiment. The West Incursion Zone shutdown puzzle is in the Unsupervised Science Walkthrough.

title: Notes From Dr. Puchalski
how: The access pipe to Testing Facility Platt is at a construction site northeast of the Central Field Office. Follow the pipe to the Testing Facility. Shut down the Testing Facility first by moving the power from two test cubes to the uncharged ones during the shutdown. The back room then opens with a Power Upgrade box and Notes From Dr. Puchalski.

title: Notes From Dr. Roth
how: The access pipe to Testing Facility Vesey is in the east of The Park. Shut down the Testing Facility by transferring power to the blinking power cores for 60 seconds. The back room then opens with a Large Resource Crate and Notes From Dr. Roth.

title: Notes From Technician Washland
how: The access pipe to Testing Facility Pearl is at the Survivalist’s Bunker Fast Travel Door in the south of the Evacuation Zone. Shut down the Testing Facility by placing five soda dispensers on the yellow squares. The back room then opens with a Power Upgrade box and Notes From Technician Washland.

title: Notes From Dr. Grant
how: The access pipe to Testing Facility Dutch is in the center of the bottom level of the Twisted Rooftops in the Unknown Zone. Shut down the Testing Facility by transferring power to the blinking power cores for 60 seconds. The back room then opens with a Large Resource Crate and Notes From Dr. Grant.

title: Dr. Grant’s Final Report
how: Once all six Testing Facilities are shut down, enter the Threshold and go to the very end of the Puchalski corridor. Dr. Grant and his Final Report are waiting there.

title: Report on Unidentified Female Subject
how: Northwest of the Oldest House is an Atlantis Coffee Shop with a secret. Read the Shop Opening Instructions, use the power switch, then turn on all appliances from smallest to biggest: 1: Radio (in the sitting area) 2: Small coffee machine (on the red counter) 3: Big coffee machine 4: Soda machine 5: Microwave 6: Fridge This opens the door to the secret basement. The Report on Unidentified Female Subject is in the second room of the basement.

title: Report On 34 Thomas Street
how: This report is in the first room of the Atlantis Coffee Shop basement, the same room as the Health Upgrade box.

title: Clarification Of Mandate
how: This e-mail is also in the first room with the Health Upgrade box.

title: Do Not Leave The Shelter
how: East of the Central Field Office, near the East Park Station, is a laundromat blocked by the Hiss. Follow the red glows to their sources and destroy them until you can enter the laundromat. Inside, read the pinboard. The puzzle uses zeros and ones, and only the rows with ones are relevant: 0 means out of order, 1 means a working washing machine. Go through the rows, find those washing machines and turn them on. The order does not matter. This opens the back door in the kitchen area. Do Not Leave The Shelter is on a table in the basement backroom with the tables and yellow chairs.

title: Visitation And Stay Protocol
how: This document is in the same backroom as Do Not Leave The Shelter, on a different table.

title: After-Action Summary
how: Southwest of the Main Street Fast Travel Door and the Vendor in the Evacuation Zone is the Konstig Gallery at street level. Read the note at the reception desk. It lists four paintings that have been sold: Journey, Windows, Thunder and Tides. Each of the four walls has three paintings and a light switch on the pillar nearby. Use the light switches to light up the paintings from the list, working from left to right (counterclockwise): Journey: Second painting on the left wall, the one with the road. Windows: First painting, the twisted branches forming windows. Thunder: First painting, the tree split in half by thunder. Tides: Second painting, the tree in the water. Light switch solution from left to right (counterclockwise): 2-1-1-2 The After-Action Summary is a red folder in the second room, on the shelf at the back.

title: Proposed Enforcement
how: This document is in the second room of the Konstig Gallery hideout, on the shelf with the weapons.

title: Workshop Journal Entries
how: The Workshop Journal Entries are in the first room of the Konstig Gallery hideout, on top of a wooden box.

title: Notice Of Decommissioning
how: South of the Park, near the Research Site, is an Atlantis Coffee Shop with a secret. Read the instructions and the coffee menu near the counter. Look up what each table on the note ordered and find its letter on the menu: Table 1: Iced Coffee: B Table 5: Spiciest Chai: D Table 4: Espresso: A Table 2: Caramel Latte: C Enter the code BDAC at the checkout to open the secret door to the basement. The Notice Of Decommissioning is on the bed in the same room as the Health Upgrade box.

title: F*ck You, Larry Note
how: This note is in the room with the shelves in the same hideout as Notice Of Decommissioning.

title: Steaming Open Envelopes
how: On the eastern side of the West Incursion Zone is the Urban Fresh Mart. Read the hint document about the soda machine, then interact with the soda machine to see the lights blink 3-1-2-1. The post-it at the checkout counter says the order is reversed, so enter the code 1-2-1-3 at the till. The secret door opens to a basement with two rooms. Steaming Open Envelopes is in the same room as the Health Upgrade box.

title: Avoid The French Delegation
how: This document is in the same basement as Steaming Open Envelopes, in the other room.

title: Audit Outcome
how: This letter is in the same room as Avoid The French Delegation and Hunka Love.

title: Procedure For Work Orders
how: Enter the gym, Pulse Fitness, in the north of the central island in the Unknown Zone. Read the flyer on the pinboard in the locker room, which describes a two-set cardio training. Then:

title: Hunka Love
how: This document is in the same room as Avoid The French Delegation and Audit Outcome.

title: Surveillance Boredom
how: This recording is in the Atlantis Coffee Shop hideout northwest of the Oldest House (see 1 – Report on Unidentified Female Subject).

title: Art Exhibition
how: The Art Exhibition is inside the Konstig Art Gallery on the ground floor, in the north of the central island (Twisted Rooftops). Arrange the four exhibits so the background squares match, in this order: Ball, Toilet, Laptop, Hoover.

title: Beach Day
how: The Beach Day sketch is at the Lookout point on the roof east of the Oldest House in Downtown. Look at the scene first, then place the umbrella and the chair as shown in the screenshot. The pieces show up as puzzle piece symbols on your minimap.

title: The Cat Picnic
how: Find the picnic blanket in Central and interact with it. Then pick up the basket and the two cats and place them in the highlighted slots (all items are marked on the HUD). Interact with the blanket once more to take The Cat Picnic sketch.

title: The Dragon and The Knight Sketch
how: The dragon is in the subway station in the northwest of the Park. Place two pizza slices as its teeth, two traffic cones on its back and two benches as its wings to complete The Dragon and The Knight sketch.

title: Game Night
how: Game Night is one Gravity Well away from Factory Island, in the southeast of the Unknown Zone. It is on the bottom level of a construction site, and you need to walk around a bit to collect all six pieces: 3 pieces for the game board, a candle from the mini-mart, a pizza from the pizza shop and a mannequin from the laundromat.

title: Dream House
how: The Dream House is on the roof of the construction site in the north of the Evacuation Zone. There are 6 items to place, all highlighted on the minimap. Of the two boards, the clean one is the roof and the filthy one goes at the entrance. The dog, the cat and the big plant go at the front, and the small plant goes to the left where the white bowl is.

title: Live on Stage
how: During the side story The Complete Set, Dylan has to find an Altered speaker in a collector’s apartment in Central. Inside the Collector’s Apartment, set up the “One Man Band” by placing 2 guitars, 1 cymbal, 1 keyboard and 1 microphone. All items are visible on the HUD. Then interact with the finished set to sketch it.

title: Halloween Party
how: The Halloween Party is on the rooftop north of the West Incursion Zone Checkpoint. Four pieces are missing, and all four are shown on the minimap. The setup is symmetrical, so place each piece to mirror the ones already there. The screenshot shows the right placement.

title: Robotics
how: Fast travel to the Survivalist’s Bunker from the side story Urban Survival. There is a second warehouse right next to the Survivalist’s warehouse. Follow the alley next to the Survivalist’s warehouse south. Before the mines start, enter the second warehouse on the right. Inside is a vending machine leaning against the warehouse shutters. It needs five pieces, a head, two arms and two legs, and they are all shown on the minimap.

title: Rooftop Oasis
how: The Rooftop Oasis is in the northwest of Downtown, where the map shows Dense Patterning. Find three ducks and three plants (they are marked on the HUD). Place the ducks around the table and the plants on the white gravel spots around the umbrella, then take the sketch.

title: Space Adventure
how: The Space Adventure is on top of the pillar northwest of the Research Site. Interact with it first, and five puzzle pieces show up on the HUD. The antenna goes on the biggest spot, marked “X”. The American flag goes at the top with the two humans around it, and the Alien stands at the back.

title: Season’s Greetings
how: Finish the game and find it by the door in Dylan’s Apartment.

title: The Master of Many Worlds
how: In the northwest of the Evacuation Zone is an apartment building you can only enter when you chase away one of the Freeze Frame Cameras. Inside this building is one apartment you can enter. Interact with the TV to receive this Archives collectible.
